how_we_decided.formula: score = 0.5 x evidence + 0.3 x distance + 0.2 x source trust - penalties

parts_explained.evidence: How completely the record names the service: supported 0.7, corroborated 1.0; thin evidence -0.2, strong +0.1.
parts_explained.distance: exp(-km / radius): 1.0 at the searched point, 0.37 at the radius.
parts_explained.trust: Independent web domains behind the record, an official website, and how recent the pages are.

how_we_decided.radius_reason: A straight-line product default for this service, not clinical guidance.
how_we_decided.score_status_note: The weights are judgment calls, not fitted. They will be replaced by a calibrated probability when outside labels are linked.
limits: Distances are straight-line kilometres, not travel time.
This dataset mostly covers private facilities with a web presence. Public hospitals are under-covered.
Evidence describes what web pages say, not what a facility can do today. Pages can be stale.
Quotes name the fact and its field, not the web page it came from: the data has no per-fact source.
The test set for the fact tagger was labeled by an AI agent, not a clinician.
Weights and radii are stated defaults, not fitted or clinically validated.
